name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (gfx/blit domain). Descriptor accurately reflects the body: a buffer blit where each copied row is given a per-row horizontal x-offset from a 16-entry table. No Ghidra address residue. Matches plate and source naming.
purpose: Per-row x-offset blit producing the chapter-background shimmer / heat-haze effect: copies a 312-byte-wide x 192-row block from src to dst, shifting each source row horizontally by a small amount read from a cyclic 16-entry offset table.
logic_summary: src_row_base = src_buf + 4 (skip 4-byte header); row_remain = 0xC0 (192 rows). Per row: src_iter = src_row_base + shimmer_offset_table[offset_idx]; REP MOVSD copies 0x4E (78) dwords = 312 bytes from src_iter into dst_buf (both advance by 4); src_row_base += 0x140 (320 src stride); offset_idx incremented and wrapped to 0 at 16 (16-bit INC DX/CMP DX,0x10/XOR DX,DX); dst_buf advances 2 dwords (8 bytes) to skip the inter-row gap, making dst a 320-byte-stride surface. Post-test do/while on row_remain.

params.name: src_buf
params.semantics: Source buffer base linear address; the 4-byte header is skipped (pixel data begins at +4). Caller passes data_fd2_graphics_static_bg_buffer_ptr (the static backdrop).
params.reason: Accurately names the source buffer base; no address residue; matches plate/source/decompiler.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Destination base, treated as uint32*; copied 78 dwords per row then advanced +2 dwords (8-byte gap) to form a 320-byte-stride surface. Caller passes data_fd2_graphics_animated_bg_buffer_ptr (the animated work buffer).
params.reason: Accurately names the destination buffer base; uint32* matches the REP MOVSD dword copy; no address residue.

params.name: offset_idx
params.semantics: Starting index (0..15) into the 16-entry shimmer offset table data_fd2_graphics_shimmer_offset_table_16b at 0x627C8; cycles +1 per row, wrapping to 0 at 16. Caller passes data_fd2_graphics_bg_animation_frame_idx (the 0..15 background animation frame counter).
params.reason: Describes its sole use as the starting index into the offset table; no address residue; matches plate/source/decompiler.

returns.semantics: No return value. Binary RET with no EAX set; cdecl, caller cleans 3 stack args.

notes: Source comment block (blitspr.c lines 1394-1429) and the offset-table global declaration (lines 27-33) were already precise, ASCII-only, and consistent with both the decompilation and the disassembly: LEA EAX,[0x627c8] (table base, byte-indexed MOV BL,[EAX+EDX]), MOV BP,0xc0 (192 rows), MOV ECX,0x4e + REP MOVSD (78 dwords), ADD ESI,0x140 (320 src stride), INC DX/CMP DX,0x10/XOR DX,DX (16-bit wrap at 16), ADD EDI,0x8 (8-byte dst row gap). The decompiler 'fixup to -> 000027c8' note is an LE relocation artifact; runtime table address is 0x627C8 as the disassembly shows. No src edit needed (comment keep). Ghidra plate is consistent (not stale/contradictory), so left untouched. Sole caller fd2_composite_battle_tile_map @ 0x11EE E (xref call site 0x11F76) invokes this once per tick on animated-background chapters 9/0x18/0x19/0x1C/0x1D.
